name: Velaa Private Island
positioning: Independent private-island resort in the Noonu Atoll of the Maldives, with villas above the lagoon, a golf academy and a spa above the water
best_for: Golfers who want one-on-one coaching on a Maldives island
Families wanting a certified kids club
Travelers seeking Ayurvedic and diagnostic wellbeing programmes

facts.text: Velaa is a turtle-shaped private island in the Noonu Atoll of the Maldives.
Each guest has a personal butler.
Guests are greeted on arrival by a Velaa airport butler and escorted to a private lounge before the seaplane transfer.
Private jets can land at Maafaru International Airport, a 7-minute seaplane ride or a 35-minute yacht ride from Velaa.
The villas are suspended above the lagoon, and every home is filled with natural light, ocean views and the colours of sand and sea.
Two-bedroom houses are made for shared days with those closest to you.
Among the private residences, one was designed by Patricia Urquiola and another by Winch Design.
The spa offers personalised facials and advanced Swiss skin treatments.
At the Velaa Wellbeing Village, the Eveylaa programme blends Ayurvedic traditions with modern diagnostics to build a tailored wellbeing plan.
The Velaa Golf Academy offers one-on-one PGA coaching, a TrackMan simulator and advanced swing analysis.
The island has a grass tennis court, a squash court and water sports from wakeboarding to kite surfing.
Tavaru, set high above the palms, serves teppanyaki, and Aragu is where East meets West.

highlights.text: The Velaa Golf Academy has a 9-hole Par-3 course designed by José María Olazábal.
The Velaa Spa sits above turquoise waters and has a snow room experience.
The resort has its own mini submarine, from which guests can spot sea turtles.
The wood-and-glass villas and residences were built to resemble sea turtles, most of them with pools.
Hidden within the Tavaru Tower is the Maldives' largest private wine cellar.

considerations.text: From Velana International Airport in Male, the island is reached by a 45-minute seaplane ride.
The golf course is a 9-hole Par-3 course built around the short game.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive private-island experience.
